Directions: Read and study the sources about Louisiana Native Americans. Then use the four sources and your knowledge of social studies to answer each question that follows.
Context: In this quotation, French explorer Henri Joutel describes Caddo homes.
Title: Source 1: From The Journals of Henri Joutel (1687)
Author: by Henri Joutel
Content: There are normally `text(eight)` or `text(ten)` families in these huts, which are very large; some are `60` `text(feet)` in diameter¹... These are round, in the shape of beehives, or rather like large haystacks... They are covered with grass from the ground to the top. They make a fire in the center, the smoke going out the top through the grass.
References: diameter: the distance through the center of a circle from one side to the other
